purpose: Teach: アワ/ニャン/童貞/メヒコ/ペセタ/ルーシー/レヴィナス/スラブ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが徳島のアワ、つまり粟料理を愛された
lines.en: Gran, when Dad was younger, he was really fond of awa — millet dishes from Tokushima.
lines.style: Soft, reaching back into memory. Gentle opening. Measured pace, like remembering something tender. Slight wistfulness on the specific detail.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、お孫様にニャンと猫の真似されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — and Grandpa, when you were young, you used to do that cat impression for the grandkids, didn't you?
lines.style: Warmth with a teasing edge. Quick, observant. Eyes crinkling. The affection of gently redirecting him, keeping the conversation alive between them.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが童貞時代の作家を志されてた事もあった
lines.en: Gran, when Dad was younger, he actually dreamed of being a novelist for a time.
lines.style: Quieter this time, like sharing something more intimate. Reflective pause before the verb. Tender, not embarrassed — protective of that younger version of his father.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、メキシコのメヒコ市にお勤めだったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, when you were young, you worked in Mexico City, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Playful counter-move. Knowing lilt. She's enjoying this — the back-and-forth, keeping him honest. Warm but slightly mischievous.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが旧スペインペセタを記念で蒐集された
lines.en: Gran, Dad collected old Spanish pesetas as keepsakes — they meant something to him.
lines.style: More deliberate now. Weight on the memory. Speaking it into the room like a small offering. Slow, careful. The reverence of an object held onto.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、ピーナッツのルーシーの漫画を愛されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, when you were young, you loved that Peanuts comic with Lucy, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Knowing amusement. She's found another one — another little fact she's kept. Quick, warm. The pleasure of remembering him remembering.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが哲学者レヴィナスの本を蔵書された
lines.en: Gran, Dad collected Levinas — the philosopher. His books were precious to him.
lines.style: Reverent, almost scholarly. Slow opening. The tone of someone speaking about things that shaped a person. Weighted with meaning.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、東欧のスラブ系民族に詳しかったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, you knew so much about the Slavic peoples of Eastern Europe when you were younger, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, admiring. Gentle. She's moved through teasing into genuine affection now. Trailing softly on his name. Eyes full.
